opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search for a return or one-way flight from an origin to a destination airport on given dates for N passengers (with an optional promo code), then select the outbound/return fares.
steps: Open ryanair.com flights tab
Choose Return trip or One way
Click From and pick origin country/airport (or type city and pick suggestion)
Click To and pick destination country/airport (or type city and pick suggestion)
In the date picker, navigate to the month and click the departure date
If return trip, click the return date
Open passengers and set the adult/teen/child/infant counts, click Done
Optionally click 'Apply promo code' and type the code
Click Search
On results, click Select for the outbound flight and then for the return flight

instances.values: Return, Dublin → Athens, 2 Apr – 5 Apr 2023, 1 adult; selected FR4518 / FR4519
One way, Dublin → Malta, 22 Apr 2023, 2 adults
Return, Tel Aviv → Venice Treviso, 9 May – 16 May 2023, 1 adult; selected FR912 / FR911
Return, Dublin → Paris Beauvais, 26 Apr – 2 May 2023, 2 adults, promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and ticket selection
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search a destination or attraction for a date, optionally apply filters/sorting, open an attraction, and choose the ticket quantities for that date.
steps: Click the Attractions tab
Type the attraction/city into 'Where are you going?' and pick the suggestion (or pick a destination from the Explore more destinations region tiles)
Open 'Select your dates' and pick the date
Click Search
Optionally tick filters (e.g., Free cancellation, City, Category) and choose a sort (e.g., Most popular)
Open the chosen attraction via 'See availability'
In Tickets and prices, choose the date if asked and set adult/child/infant counts
Click Next

instances.values: Aquarium of Paris, 5 May 2023; opened the attraction and adjusted the ticket picker
Asia → Kyoto, 25 May 2023, Free cancellation + Kyoto + Tours, Most popular; Fushimi Inari Shrine Hiking Tour, 2 adults + 1 infant, then Next (interrupted by Resy browsing)

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant availability notify
opportunities.description: On Resy, search for a restaurant by name or cuisine, open it, set the date and party size, and set a Notify alert for a meal period and time window.
steps: Type the restaurant name or cuisine into 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.'
Click the matching restaurant in the suggestions
Open the date picker and choose the date
Set the Guests dropdown to the party size
Click 'Notify' for the desired meal period (Lunch/Dinner)
If prompted, set the preferred start and end times
Click Confirm

instances.values: query 'thai' → Senyai Thai Kitchen, Thu Apr 6 2023, 2 guests, Dinner notify 5:00 PM–7:00 PM
